text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
On the way home, Mihono Bourbon mentions 
that she would like to try running in 
bigger races.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She had always been poor at expressing her 
emotions and rarely asserted herself, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Through numerous contests with rivals, she 
seems to have awakened to the joy of 
running in races.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Having also achieved great growth, Rice 
Shower invited her to a rematch at the 
Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A grand race bringing Rice Shower, Mejiro 
McQueen, and Tokai Teio all together under 
one roof. Mihono Bourbon's eyes sparkled 
with excitement.
